crowbar/paid-ads.description: When the user wants help with paid advertising campaigns on Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, or other ad platforms. Covers campaign strategy, audience targeting, and optimization.

crowbar/paywall-upgrade-cro.name: Paywall & Upgrade CRO
crowbar/paywall-upgrade-cro.description: When the user wants to create or optimize in-app paywalls, upgrade screens, upsell modals, or feature gates. Focuses on in-product upgrade moments where the user has already experienced value.

crowbar/popup-cro.name: Popup CRO
crowbar/popup-cro.description: When the user wants to create or optimize popups, modals, overlays, slide-ins, or banners for conversion purposes.

crowbar/pricing-strategy.name: Pricing Strategy
crowbar/pricing-strategy.description: When the user wants help with pricing decisions, packaging, or monetization strategy. Covers pricing research, tier structure, and packaging strategy.

crowbar/product-marketing-context.name: Product Marketing Context
crowbar/product-marketing-context.description: When the user wants to create or update their product marketing context document. Creates .agents/product-marketing-context.md that other marketing skills reference.

crowbar/programmatic-seo.name: Programmatic SEO
crowbar/programmatic-seo.description: When the user wants to create SEO-driven pages at scale using templates and data. Covers directory pages, location pages, comparison pages, and integration pages.

crowbar/referral-program.name: Referral Program
crowbar/referral-program.description: When the user wants to create, optimize, or analyze a referral program, affiliate program, or word-of-mouth strategy. Covers program design, incentive structure, and growth optimization.

crowbar/revops.name: RevOps
crowbar/revops.description: When the user wants help with revenue operations, lead lifecycle management, or marketing-to-sales handoff processes. Covers lead scoring, lead routing, CRM automation, and data hygiene.

crowbar/sales-enablement.name: Sales Enablement
crowbar/sales-enablement.description: When the user wants to create sales collateral, pitch decks, one-pagers, objection handling docs, or demo scripts.

crowbar/schema-markup.name: Schema Markup
crowbar/schema-markup.description: When the user wants to add, fix, or optimize schema markup and structured data on their site. Covers JSON-LD, rich snippets, FAQ schema, product schema, and more.

crowbar/seo-audit.name: SEO Audit
crowbar/seo-audit.description: When the user wants to audit, review, or diagnose SEO issues on their site. Covers technical SEO, on-page SEO, meta tags, and SEO health checks.

crowbar/signup-flow-cro.name: Signup Flow CRO
crowbar/signup-flow-cro.description: When the user wants to optimize signup, registration, account creation, or trial activation flows.

crowbar/site-architecture.name: Site Architecture
crowbar/site-architecture.description: When the user wants to plan, map, or restructure their website's page hierarchy, navigation, URL structure, or internal linking.

crowbar/social-content.name: Social Content
crowbar/social-content.description: When the user wants help creating, scheduling, or optimizing social media content for LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, or other platforms.
